title: One question. A research team.
takeaway: One research question can become coordinated specialist work.
proof: Three real concurrent child tasks analyze separate signals, one opens briefly, then their findings rejoin.
limits: Deterministic SDK specialist procedures; bootstrap is illustrative, not a causal finding.
hardest: Peer cards must clear before the particle inspector expands, while other work stays visible.

copy.text: Specialists work together, with distinct assignments.
